name: Séance Chamber
description: A circular room draped in dark velvet, lit by candles that burn with green flames. A round table sits in the center with a Ouija board that spells out stock tips. The walls are covered in mystical symbols, half of which are definitely made up. Incense smoke forms suspicious shapes. A crystal ball shows only static. Somewhere, a theremin plays itself. This is either the real deal or the world's most committed theme room—the hotel reviews are mixed.
